chebyshev_identity_block.detail: GPU and CPU branches initialize psi0 to zero, write the identity orbital block at each recursion site, then compute Chebyshev moments.

rs_and_dos_dispatch.detail: The RS recursion selector calls chebyshev_recur for Chebyshev mode; DOS selects Chebyshev spectral reconstruction.

full_g0.detail: GPU and CPU branches reconstruct the full nb-by-nb matrix Green function from deterministic moments.

occupation_P.detail: For both spin channels and all orbital-pair indices in each l block, matrix spectral density is integrated with Simpson moment=0 into potential%ldm; the d block is 5x5.

local_M1.detail: For each orbital pair and spin, the same spectral density is integrated with Simpson moment=1 into M1; local mode selects/associates the M1 target at source/bands.f90:948-962.

local_correction.detail: Current d-block P, M1, and stored Hubbard potential block are passed to correct_d_shell_moments; corrected center and q2 are applied to the radial potential.

existing_guard.detail: Correction helper checks finite P/M1/V/q0/c/q2, P density diagnostics/Hermiticity/eigenvalue bounds, q0>0, and finite correction outputs.

stochastic_separation.detail: The stochastic routine is transport; random_vec_num is read only in the random_vec cond_calctype branch. No random-vector count is used by the fixed-U SCF recursion/P/M1 path.

adapter_design.c3_cases_and_metrics: From exact capture operands construct the raw/spectral and local-corrected replay cases using captured P, M1, Vin, q0, center and q2. Record per-spin carrier ratio from measured replay energy response divided by the captured trace(Vin P) carrier; gate only each spin ratio in [0.99,1.01]. Compute and report q2prime from the registered local formula and gate q2prime >= 0. Auxiliary wrong-control outputs, if retained, are RECORDS only.
